reading.title: Mill Street Lofts: annual certificates and end of the affordability period

candidates.quote: This memo reports the status of the yearly owner certificates for Mill Street Lofts under the Regulatory Agreement dated June 14, 2011, and notes the upcoming end of the affordability period.
The certificate for reporting year 2025 was due on March 31, 2026 and is marked not received.
Under Section 5.1 of the agreement, the affordability period ends on December 31, 2026.
